name: Mace of Disruption
description: A silver-flanged mace that hums when the dead are near.
body:
## What it does

A fiend or an undead it hits takes holy damage besides, and one left with 25 hit points or fewer must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be destroyed. A success leaves it frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

## Light

Held, it sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 beyond.

damage.note: against a fiend or an undead

features.name: Disruption
features.text: A fiend or undead it leaves at 25 hit points or fewer makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is destroyed; on a success it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
